indexes.name: unread_count_signals_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unread_count_signals_pkey ON public.unread_count_signals USING btree (id)

indexes.name: unread_count_signals_user_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unread_count_signals_user_id_key ON public.unread_count_signals USING btree (user_id)

policies.name: unread_count_signals_owner_select
policies.qual: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (app_security.get_account_status(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) = ANY (ARRAY['active'::account_status_enum, 'suspended'::account_status_enum])))

triggers.name: hdr03_message_arrival
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER hdr03_message_arrival AFTER INSERT ON messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_security.hdr03_signal_message()

triggers.name: hdr03_read_state_insert
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER hdr03_read_state_insert AFTER INSERT ON conversation_read_states FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_security.hdr03_signal_read_state()

triggers.name: hdr03_read_state_update
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER hdr03_read_state_update AFTER UPDATE OF last_read_message_id ON conversation_read_states FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.last_read_message_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.last_read_message_id) EXECUTE FUNCTION app_security.hdr03_signal_read_state()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_security.hdr03_signal_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.unread_count_signals as s (user_id)
  select participant from public.conversations c
  cross join lateral (values (c.buyer_id), (c.seller_id)) p(participant)
  where c.id = new.conversation_id and participant is not null
    and participant is distinct from new.sender_id
  order by participant
  on conflict (user_id) do update set revision = s.revision + 1;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_security.hdr03_signal_read_state()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.unread_count_signals as s (user_id) values (new.user_id)
  on conflict (user_id) do update set revision = s.revision + 1;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_unread_counts()
 RETURNS TABLE(unread_messages bigint, unread_notifications bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null or coalesce(app_security.get_account_status(v_uid)::text, '') not in ('active', 'suspended') then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Authentication or account access required';
  end if;

  -- Count messages, not conversations; never count the caller's own messages.
  -- last_read_at is when a read was recorded, NOT the message ordering cursor.
  select count(*) into unread_messages
  from public.conversations c
  join public.messages m on m.conversation_id = c.id
  left join public.conversation_read_states r on r.conversation_id = c.id and r.user_id = v_uid
  left join public.messages marker on marker.conversation_id = r.conversation_id and marker.id = r.last_read_message_id
  where (c.buyer_id = v_uid or c.seller_id = v_uid)
    and m.sender_id is distinct from v_uid
    and (marker.id is null or (m.created_at, m.id) > (marker.created_at, marker.id));

  select count(*) into unread_notifications
  from public.notifications n where n.user_id = v_uid and n.read_at is null;

  -- count(*) is non-negative bigint; reject values JS cannot represent exactly.
  if unread_messages > 9007199254740991 or unread_notifications > 9007199254740991 then
    raise exception using errcode = '22003', message = 'Unread count out of range';
  end if;
  return next;
end;
$function$

constraints.name: unread_count_signals_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
